name: X-LAB GT8 GRX Di2
why_interesting: A current 8.78 kg claimed gravel complete with GRX Di2, a dual-sided power meter, carbon wheels, storage and 55 mm clearance.
missing: Final mainland checkout and stock confirmation
Exact domestic included-accessory list, warranty and service terms
price_status: reported mainland complete-bike price; final checkout unverified
required_before_dashboard: Mainland-China purchase route, dated checkout price, and domestic configuration/warranty evidence
source_note: A 2026-08-21 mainland market aggregation reports first dealer arrivals and a CNY 21,980 complete-bike price, closely matching an earlier public-post market lead near CNY 22,000. It is not an official list price or verified final checkout. Official international price remains US$3,199.

facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer claimed size-M complete-bike value; an independent test measured approximately 8.8 kg ready to ride without pedals
facts.frame_material: Toray T800 carbon frame and fork
facts.frame_construction: Internally routed UDH carbon gravel frame with T47 shell, integrated downtube storage and carbon cockpit and seatpost
facts.stiffness_evidence: An independent exact-model test reports notable compliance and a muted ride with race-oriented handling; this is qualitative ride evidence and no measured stiffness value was published
facts.cockpit: Branta carbon stem and gravel carbon handlebar
facts.mounts: Top tube, downtube and both fork legs
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL and XXL

support_note: Official page states a 110 kg rider-plus-cargo limit, local-bike-shop general service, dealer support for warranty/customization, 1× and 2× drivetrain compatibility, 27.2 mm dropper compatibility, and tubeless-ready wheels/tires.
